item.title: AI giant Palantir moves its headquarters to Florida as tech company exodus continues
item.description: Palantir joins the tech exodus to Florida as the AI innovator relocates its headquarters to Miami, following billionaires like Bezos and Thiel to the Sunshine State.

item.title: Bipartisan bill looks to prepare workforce for AI future: 'Can't be left behind'
item.description: Bipartisan lawmakers introduced AI legislation that would offer companies a tax credit for training their employees to use artificial intelligence.

item.title: Rent becoming more affordable for many Americans as market stabilizes
item.description: A housing market shift is giving renters more bargaining power as vacancy rates rise and median households spend 24.3% of income on rent, down from pandemic highs.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg faces jury in landmark trial over alleged youth harm linked to social media
item.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg testifies in court for first time over youth safety allegations in landmark social media harm lawsuit reshaping tech industry.

item.title: Ohio governor says ending property taxes could push state's sales tax to 20%
item.description: A proposed Ohio property tax ban could create a $24 billion budget hole, forcing tax hikes to avoid massive cuts to schools, police and fire service across the state.

item.title: Chrysler recalls over 80K vehicles due to springs that may detach while driving
item.description: Chrysler is recalling over 80,000 Jeep Grand Cherokee SUVs due to rear coil springs that may detach while driving, creating dangerous road hazards for vehicles.

item.title: Fed dissent grows as some officials weigh return to interest rate hikes amid stubborn inflation
item.description: The minutes of the Federal Reserve's January meeting revealed policymakers considered language about possible rate hikes amid concerns over elevated inflation.

item.title: Grandson of Reese’s inventor blasts Hershey over alleged recipe changes: 'I threw it in the garbage'
item.description: Reese's founder's grandson accuses Hershey of quietly changing beloved candy recipes, replacing milk chocolate and peanut butter with cheaper substitutes.

item.title: Kevin Hassett says Fed economists should be 'disciplined' over tariff study
item.description: White House economic advisor Kevin Hassett called for the New York Fed to discipline economists over research showing U.S. businesses and consumers bear most of the tariff burden.

item.title: Beloved Iowa pizza franchise serves up ‘more than pizza’ for its customers
item.description: Happy Joe's Pizza reports "milestone" growth in 2025 with new franchise locations across Texas, Iowa, and Arizona as the brand continues expanding.
